title: Best Trash Can (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the cited sources (Amazon Basics, Simplehuman). Other picks were included for breadth and to cover outdoor and car use. Sources used: 1, 4, 5, 3.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide a consistent price for each item.

verdict.line: Picture a small kitchen where a 13‑gallon can fits neatly under the counter. The Amazon Basics model locks in odors, is easy to clean, and is priced well below many competitors. The main catch is that it has a plastic body, which may not feel as premium as stainless steel.
